name: kirby-pagestree-section
description: Kirby 5 and 6 Panel plugin that displays pages as a collapsible tree view
author: Jens Fendinger

scripts.build:k5: npx -y kirbyup@3 src/k5/index.js && node scripts/stage-bundles.mjs k5
scripts.build:k6: npx -y kirbyup@4 src/k6/index.js && node scripts/stage-bundles.mjs k6
scripts.build: npm run build:k5 && npm run build:k6
